title: Keep track of a date
intro: Copy a date from your receipt or message. Lift does not calculate or confirm your legal deadline.
process: Which process does the receipt name?
date: Date printed on the receipt or message
source: Where did you find this date?
confirm: I have checked that this date matches the receipt or message. This does not confirm that it is an official deadline.
empty: No dates added yet. You can add one without creating a plan.
privacy: Dates follow your plan-saving setting. With saving off, they stay in this tab until you close or reload it. Shared-phone users should leave saving off.
calendarNote: This downloads a file; it does not set an alarm automatically. Open it in your calendar and check the date and notification settings. Calendar apps may sync it to your account.
neutral: Calendar entries use a neutral title and contain no immigration details.
eventBody: A date I entered in Lift. It is not a confirmed legal deadline. Check the original source.
error: Choose a valid date and confirm you checked it against the source.
full: You can keep up to six dates. Remove one before adding another.
past: This date is in the past. Check the original source; Lift cannot determine whether anything is overdue.
unverified: Date entered by you — not independently confirmed
stored: This date is saved on this browser because plan saving is on.
clear: Clearing your Lift plan also removes your saved dates. Downloaded calendar files remain in your files or calendar.
review: Please check the process and date with a trusted adviser if you are unsure. Do not infer your right to stay or work from a reminder.
